lines.1: 「Hey, quit grinning and get up already.」
lines.4: Somehow, she has already invaded my room.
lines.5: 「Good morning. You would not wake up, so I have taken the liberty of attacking you.」
lines.6: I see. She's stepping on my shoulder.
lines.12: 「...Well, I am glad to see you are healthy. ............That was my first time seeing one............」
lines.13: Otome marches straight out of the room.
lines.14: 「What got into her...? Otome's acting weird.」
lines.15: Maybe my just-woke-up look was overwhelmingly sexy for a man.
lines.16: Then I happen to look down.
lines.17: Apparently it was hot last night, so I slept in nothing but my boxers.
lines.18: And the dream I just had was about the Princess.
lines.20: My crotch is extremely lively right now.
lines.21: 「Well, it's a natural bodily function. Can't be helped.」
lines.22: I tell myself that and get ready for school.
lines.23: I thought things might be a little awkward, but Otome acts perfectly normal.
lines.26: I already know they're rice balls, so I ask about the fillings.
lines.27: 「Salted kelp, natto, senmaizuke pickles... As for the rest, you can enjoy finding out when you eat them. That is part of the pleasure.」
